why_ai: Unlicensed SaaS, but embedded POS hardware and payments slow displacement by AI-native rivals.
why_clarity: Sales and labour forecasts are checked against actuals daily, though menu and catalogue mapping is messy.
why_digital: Transaction data and software, with POS hardware shipped and local sales reps.

why_ai: Pour-versus-sale reconciliation is arithmetic once measured, leaving only the physical capture hard.
why_clarity: Variance between poured and sold is an exact figure, checked every count.
why_digital: Starts from physical bottles and pours measured in bars, reconciled in software.

why_ai: Menu translation between structured catalogues is a mapping problem automation is solving.
why_clarity: A menu is either correct on every channel or it is not, checked on every order.
why_digital: Menu catalogues in, synced channel menus out, all software.

why_ai: Forecasting on captured data is well-posed, but POS hardware and payments keep incumbents sticky.
why_clarity: Forecasts are checked against each day's sales, though chains and independents need different methods.
why_digital: Software and terminals sold to restaurants, partly through local reps.

why_ai: Cost apportionment is accounting, but tenant acceptance of fairness involves contested judgement.
why_clarity: Allocations recur, but what counts as fair is argued rather than agreed.
why_digital: Booking and cost data in, allocations out, sold to local facility operators.

why_ai: Pooling comparable locations' history is a standard modelling technique AI-native tools will ship.
why_clarity: Every day's covers and prep are forecast and checked against actuals that night.
why_digital: Transaction history in, forecasts out, sold to owner-operators.

why_ai: Mapping invoice lines to ingredients is catalogue entity matching with abundant training data.
why_clarity: Automatic match rate is an exact, repeated measure across every invoice line.
why_digital: Invoice images and catalogues in, plate costs out.

why_ai: Prep quantities and par levels are computable, so AI-native tools can supply them easily.
why_clarity: Prep lists and pars repeat daily and are checked by what runs out during service.
why_digital: Software must reach wet-handed cooks in a physical kitchen still using printed sheets.

why_ai: Constrained scheduling against a demand forecast is a well-posed optimisation problem.
why_clarity: Share of shifts surviving the week is an exact measure, recomputed weekly.
why_digital: Availability and forecasts in, schedules out on staff phones.

why_ai: Reconciliation and variance investigation by analysts is automatable, though enterprise contracts are sticky.
why_clarity: Standardised unit metrics are defined and variance is checked every reporting period.
why_digital: Store data in, above-store reporting out, sold through enterprise sales.

why_ai: Menu planning under nutrition, allergen and budget constraints is an optimisation problem software solves.
why_clarity: Nutrition and allergen compliance are checkable, though acceptance by diners is partly taste.
why_digital: Menus and nutrition data in, cycle menus out, sold through district procurement.
